title: Lovable May 2026 Update: Creative Engine, Design Previews, and What Changed
summary: Lovable's May 2026 update shipped the Creative Engine, design previews, subagents, and Skills. Here's what actually changed — and where the same gaps remain.
body_markdown: Subagents (launched May 27, 2026) are temporary read-only agents that help Lovable investigate complex tasks faster by splitting research, code exploration, and documentation lookup into parallel work streams. Subagents cannot edit, create, or delete files — all changes still come from the main Lovable agent. They help most with large multi-file investigations where understanding the codebase first makes the actual edit faster. For straightforward single-feature builds, they're not particularly visible.[Blink](https://blink.new/) uses a similar parallel task approach under the hood, with the full backend included so the agent isn't context-switching between the app and an external Supabase project.
